name: fix-pos-table-merge-feedback
title: Fix false POS table merge errors and missing split feedback
description: Separate successful merge/split mutations from table-list refresh failures and show accurate POS notifications for modal and drag-drop actions.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Root cause traced: mergeTables/splitTables await refetch after the backend mutation. A refresh rejection bubbles into POS catch handlers, so a committed merge is reported as failed. POS split handlers also omit success notifications.
